# utils.solver.validate_monotonic_grid { #climatecritters.utils.solver.validate_monotonic_grid }

```python
utils.solver.validate_monotonic_grid(values, name='grid')
```

Validate a strictly increasing 1-D coordinate array.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**values**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[array](`array`) - [like](`like`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Coordinate values to validate.

<code>[**name**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'grid\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Label used in error messages.  Default ``'grid'``.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**arr**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ndarray](`ndarray`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Validated, flattened float array.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ValueError](`ValueError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If the array has fewer than 2 points or is not strictly increasing.
